## Interactive Simulation

Enter two numbers below. The calculation will be performed by your Python backend (FastAPI).

<div>
  <label>Parameter X: <input type="number" id="valX" value="10"></label><br>
  <label>Parameter Y: <input type="number" id="valY" value="5"></label><br>
  <button onclick="runSim()" style="margin-top:10px; padding:5px 10px; cursor:pointer;">Run Simulation</button>
</div>

<div id="result-box" style="margin-top: 20px; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #ddd; background: #f9f9f9;">
  Waiting for input...
</div>

<script>
async function runSim() {
  const x = document.getElementById('valX').value;
  const y = document.getElementById('valY').value;
  const resultBox = document.getElementById('result-box');

  resultBox.innerHTML = "Computing...";

  try {
    // On appelle l'adresse de ton serveur FastAPI
    const response = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/run-simulation', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ x: parseFloat(x), y: parseFloat(y) })
    });

    const data = await response.json();

    // Affichage du résultat
    resultBox.innerHTML = `<strong>Result from Python:</strong> ${data.result}`;

  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error:", error);
    resultBox.innerHTML = "<span style='color:red'>Error: Backend is likely offline.</span>";
  }
}
</script>
